question: the console's medium commands: what was left unread

addresses.name: ConsoleCmd_TeleportSelectionTo
addresses.comment: **The `teleportselectionto` / `teleport` console command** ('Teleports currently selected unit to location', argument 'province id'). No argument: 'Please specify the province id.'. Takes the in-game screen's selected unit (slot 40); refuses with 'Select transportable unit first!' unless the unit's slot 15 answers true, or false with its slot 9 object's +0x300 zero; otherwise CUnit::CancelMovement and CUnit::EnterProvince(provinces[id]) - no adjacency, ownership or terrain test, and no upper bound on the id seen - 'Unit moved.'. Which units slot 15 admits was not read. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-console.md. Read whole 2026-11-09: slot 15 is IsLand and slot 9 AsArmy, so the refusal is no unit selected, or a land unit aboard a fleet (CArmy +0x300 carried_by non-null); a fleet or an air unit goes. A province id of 0 or less returns with the reply's text empty and its success byte unset.
addresses.revises: Which units slot 15 admits was not read; it is now.
addresses.evidence: the handler 0x43FA70 read whole in the decompiler; vftable slots 9 and 15 of CUnit in the record

addresses.name: ConsoleCmd_Debug
addresses.comment:
**The `debug <word>` console command** ('Various debugging actions'; its argument text lists the 15 words), one function 0x441520..0x442578 that compares the first argument against literals in turn, exactly and case-sensitively. `info`, `profile`, `log_profile` flip bits 0x2000000, 0x800000, 0x400000 of GameSettings +0xEC (each also copies bit 0 into render_trees +0xE4); `tooltips` flips g_TooltipsEnabled; `assert` flips g_AssertsEnabled; `textures` writes the graphics' texture list to the log; `fow` flips g_FogOfWarEnabled and asks the in-game screen for a whole map refresh (+0x84 = -1, -1 pushed on +0x88); `nopopup` flips g_NoPopups; `spy` g_SpyCheat; `yesmen` g_AiYesmen; `wireframe` flips g_ConsoleWireframe, mirrors it to graphics +0x6BC44 and sets D3DRS_FILLMODE to wireframe/solid; `minzoom N` sets MapCamera +0x35C lowest_height_setting to N where N > 0; `render` alone prints the ten layer bits of +0xF0 AND +0xEC, `render <LAYER>` (upper-cased with CharUpperBuffA) flips one of TREES 0x1, BORDERS 0x2, TEXT 0x8, OVERLAY 0x10, OBJECTS 0x20, MAPOBJECTS 0x40, RIVERS 0x80, WATER 0x100, WATERBORDERS 0x200, EFFECTS 0x400 in +0xEC; `color TAG r g b` (0..255 each, divided by 255.0) sets a country's map colour (0x4CCD00) and refreshes the map; `save TAG` calls 0x4F5730, 'Country color saved'. No argument: 'Please specify some arguments.'; an unknown word: an empty reply. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-console.md. Read 2026-11-09: `minzoom` with fewer than two arguments answers 'Please specify zoomlevel value.' and its reply is the figure through FormatFloat3 whether or not it was above nought. `render` alone answers '----------------------------------
Render options:
', then '		Trees:	' and 'yes
' or 'no
' for each layer in the order of the bits, then the rule and a line break; `render <LAYER>` answers nothing. `color` wants exactly five words, else '4 more arguments needed: country tag, red, green, blue', an unknown tag 'Invalid country Tag', and answers 'Color applied to ' and the country's name.
addresses.revises: The replies of minzoom, render and color were not given.
addresses.evidence: the handler 0x441520 read in the decompiler, its literals and branches

addresses.name: ConsoleCmd_AiPause
addresses.comment: **The `aipause` console command** ('Pause AI for specified country or for all.', arguments '<country tag>' and '<all>'). No argument: lists the countries whose AI (CCountry +0x1D8) has ai_paused (+0x128) set, 'AI is paused for:' and the tags six to a line, or 'None'. `all`: if any live country's AI is paused, unpauses all ('AI Unpaused for all'), else pauses all ('AI Paused for all'). A tag: flips that country's ai_paused - '<name> AI is now Paused' / 'Unpaused' - or '<name> is not controlled by AI' where it has no AI object; 'Invalid country tag' / 'Please specify country tag, or "all" argument'. While set, ProcessAI does nothing for the country. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-console.md. The list read 2026-11-09: 'AI is paused for:\n', then each country's tag followed by ', ', a line break after every sixth, 'None' where there are none; `all` tests one argument, and more than one argument gets the 'Please specify' answer.
addresses.revises: The form of the list was given only as six to a line.
addresses.evidence: the handler 0x443720 read in the decompiler

addresses.name: ConsoleCmd_ReloadInterface
addresses.comment: The console command `reloadinterface` ("Reloads the entire interface"): with no arguments, CInGameIdler_BuildViews on the in-game screen (g_CCurrentGameState +0xBE8) where there is one, and the reply `Interface reloaded.`. It remakes the side menus and opens none. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-leftovermenus.md, section B.2. With any argument it answers 'Invalid arguments count' (no full stop).
addresses.evidence: the handler 0x43B610 read in the decompiler

addresses.name: GameState_WriteDetailedLog
addresses.no_signature: The file name is a std::string passed by value on the stack, seven dwords, which the decompiler does not resolve.
addresses.comment: **What the console's `detailedlog` writes.** Opens a file through 0xA6C1B0 and writes, by SaveWriteKey, SaveWriteValue and each object's own save slot: the counters `rebel`, `convoy`, `theatre` and `unit`; the rebel factions; a walk of records through 0xA79D40 with text values; `sunk_ships`; `weather`; `combat`; `active_war`, `previous_war` and `undeclared_war`. So the shape of a savegame without its head - no date, player or settings. The walks between the keys were not read record by record. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-console.md.
addresses.evidence: read in the decompiler for its keys and their order; the walks' contents are inferred from the keys

addresses.name: CCountry_SetMapColour
addresses.no_signature: Register-only: the country in ECX, the colour in EAX, no stack argument.
addresses.comment: **The country's map colour set.** Copies 0x15 bytes of a CColor (from its +4) to CCountry +0xC34..+0xC48. Its caller here is the console's `debug color`, which then remakes the map's colour textures with Map_RefreshColourTextures. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-console.md.
addresses.evidence: the function 0x4CCD00 is six moves and a ret, read in the decompiler
